entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A renowned Warrior Poet from Ixalan and planeswalker, master of mounted warfare who summons dinosaur allies.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: Huatli's home plane, where she was long trapped by a magical artifact.

events.summary: Huatli is trapped on her home plane for many years by a magical artifact.
events.quote: After spending many years trapped on her home plane by a magical artifact

events.summary: Huatli is freed to explore her powers as a planeswalker and defends the innocent from deadly threats.
events.quote: Huatli was only recently freed to explore her powers as a Planeswalker.
